entities.name: BioD (Q1QJL1)
observations: Exact sequence match (212 aa) to reviewed Nitrobacter hamburgensis ATP-dependent dethiobiotin synthetase; annotation supports EC 6.3.3.3.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of 7,8-diaminopelargonic acid plus CO2 to dethiobiotin; Mg2+ cofactor; assigned cytoplasmic localization.
Sequence-derived properties: 22,876 Da, pI 5.84; Pfam AAA_26 match spans residues 4–191.

entities.name: Biotin biosynthesis
observations: BioD catalyzes an early step converting 7,8-diaminopelargonic acid to dethiobiotin.
